Not sure what "equal pay" is about, but if we are talking "fair wage", I don't think it is established. The economy doesn't work like theories because different people have different controls over themselves. The prices keep going up (inflation); the companies keep increasing the prices of their products & services to pay for the increased prices of someone else; most workers don't have control over their own wage to accommodate. Hence, in the practical sense, the wages of most workers have been declining, which is not fair. If the workers had full control over their own wages, all the prices of goods & services will go up while the wages also go up accordingly. However, in the reality, the economy doesn't work rationally; only the prices of goods & services go up while the wages don't go up as much. This is a matter of control; it is not a matter of rational economic phenomenon.
